candidates.file: File:Rear Adm. Parks saluted at Chicago Bears Monday Night Football game DVIDS1123447.jpg
candidates.description: CHICAGO - Rear Adm. Mike Parks, commander, Ninth Coast Guard District, is recognized during the Chicago Bears-Detroit Lions Monday Night Football Game at Soldier Field in Chicago, Oct. 22, 2012. As part of the Bears/Boeing Military Salute during each home game, a deserving member of the military is saluted during an on-field recognition in the third quarter. Photo courtesy of Chicago Bears.
